title: Food and nutrition
info: Healthy food gives our bodies energy and nutrients to grow and stay strong.
Fruits and vegetables provide vitamins. Grains give energy. Protein helps build muscles.
Water is essential. We should drink plenty of water every day.
A balanced meal includes different food groups. Too much sugar or junk food is not healthy.
